exposure: neonatal respiratory morbidity (acute respiratory disease, bronchopulmonary dysplasia)
cohort: The study included a national cohort of 1,790,241 individuals born in Denmark between 1980 and 2009.
finding: There was a strong dose-response association between gestational age and prescription asthma medication purchase in infancy and childhood, which weakened into young adulthood and was only partly explained by neonatal respiratory morbidity.
followup_time: up to 31 years (from birth in 1980 to data collection in 2011)
cross-section timing: The outcome of asthma medication purchase was evaluated cross-sectionally in 2010-2011.
gest_age: All gestational ages were included, categorized into 23-27 weeks, 28-31 weeks, 32-36 weeks, and 37-42 weeks (term).
